terra.problem: Solomon being David's son is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Papa describes himself driving to a store. Activities outside his bakery should be things people do, not things he does.
The passage does not say the queen came from far away.
The passage does not say how long the queen's trip was.
The passage does not say the queen had heard about all the things she saw. Her report concerned Solomon's words and wisdom.
The queen says not even half was told to her during her visit, not as she walks out.
The passage does not say how long the queen's journey was.
The queen says Solomon's wisdom and prosperity exceeded the report, but that does not establish that nothing in the report was overblown.
David being Solomon's father and an earlier king is outside this passage and needs a reference.
Hiram's title, king of Tyre, is from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying the reason for Solomon's throne was not about being impressive adds a reason the queen does not address.
The passage compares the abundance of the spices, not the entire gift.
Nobody beating the whole gift goes beyond the passage's comparison of the spices.
The passage does not say that no guards got anything out of the wood. It says the instruments were for the singers.
Solomon being David's son is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not establish that nobody went to Egypt to study. It simply does not say Solomon studied there.
